opening.argument: The interview presents Polybius's ICO as an investment opportunity tied directly to the project. The speaker says, “The ICO has been extended for another 24 hours. Till tomorrow, or till 3 o'clock. 25% bonus,” creating a time-limited reason to act while offering an incentive whose eligibility terms are not specified. The closing instruction is explicit: “follow the ICO flow and invest, you can on the PolybiusIO site.” The discussion also attributes dividends to a token, stating, “At this moment there is the Dividendy token and it provides some dividends.” The interview format and identification of a Polybius community manager connect these investment directions to the branded project, while the separate request to subscribe and watch other videos is ordinary audience engagement.
